brand: Stone Med Spa (trading name unconfirmed — Asana says 'Stone Med Spa', Instagram says 'Westlake Medical Aesthetics')
blocked_by: Scope question: which brand owns the med spa menu. See docs/project-overview.md.

source.note: Eleven subtasks, all with empty descriptions. URLs, templates and section spines below are proposed from competitive research, not from a brief.

templates.T2-content: Standard content page with section spine and closing CTA.
templates.T3-bio-grid: Team grid, credentials in the heading, grouped by role.
templates.T4-services-hub: Dual-axis hub: by treatment and by concern.
templates.T5-service-detail: Ten-part treatment page. Botox is the sample and the template.
templates.T6-proof: Stacked proof: before/after, written reviews, video, authenticity FAQ.
templates.T7-conversion: Form-led booking page with treatment multi-select.

pages.title: Home
sections: Trust row — credentials, affiliations, review count
What would you like to change? (axis B, concern entry)
Meet Dr. Mona Stone — short, links to full bio
pages.model: Beverly Hills Med Spa — 404 words, 8 sections, awards and press above the fold

pages.title: About Us
pages.note: The practice's story, not the doctor's bio. Keep the two separate.

pages.title: Meet The Doctor
sections: Credentials — board-certified oral & maxillofacial surgeon, DDS
pages.note: Carries the practice's clinical authority. A surgeon behind a med spa is the differentiator.

pages.title: Meet the Team
pages.model: Viva /about/med-spa-staff/ — grouped by role, credentials in the heading

pages.title: Services Overview
pages.note: Both axes land on the same service detail pages. Axis B ships as in-page anchors in phase 1 and is promoted to real /concerns/* pages later without changing any published URL.
pages.model: Beverly Hills /concerns (24 pages + search) and NassifMD /conditions-treated/ (8 pages)

pages.title: Service Page Sample (Botox)
pages.note: The sample is the template for the entire menu. Build it as such.
pages.model: NassifMD /injectables/botox/ (1,420 words, 14 sections) plus Skin Solutions' pre/post-care block

pages.title: Testimonials / Before and After Gallery
pages.blocker: Before-and-after photography cannot be published without current written consent per case. 15 archived galleries exist and none are cleared. Design the page to degrade: reviews + video only if consent is not obtained in time.
pages.model: Beverly Hills /results and Skin Solutions /before-and-afters (291 images)

pages.title: Financing
pages.note: Vendor-FAQ structure, not a sales page. Only 1 of the 5 benchmark sites has a financing page at all — the Texas practice-attached one. Vendors to confirm with the client.

pages.title: Book Consultation - Virtual and In-Office
pages.open_question: None of the 5 benchmark sites offers a virtual consultation. Before design: who takes the call, on what platform, and is it HIPAA-compliant? A video visit is a clinical service, not a form field.

pages.title: Membership Plan
pages.note: Two architectures observed: named tiers (Skin Solutions — 'High Maintenance' / 'Low Maintenance') or fee + account credit + partner perks (Ject). 4 of 5 benchmark sites run a membership; 2 put it in the primary nav.

pages.title: General Thank You Page
pages.note: None of the 5 benchmark sites exposes one. It is a conversion-tracking endpoint by convention.

required_before_launch_not_in_asana_list.title: Contact
required_before_launch_not_in_asana_list.why: Address, hours, map, phone. Distinct from booking. All 5 benchmark sites have it.

phase_2_not_funded.note: The eleven-page brief funds one service page. These are the natural expansion and the URL scheme above is designed to accept them without redirects.
phase_2_not_funded.service_detail_pages: One per treatment, on template T5
phase_2_not_funded.concern_pages: /concerns/<slug> — promoted from the axis-B anchors on /services

global.cta_rationale: Consultative, not transactional. Stone sells a surgeon's treatment plan, not an appointment slot. Transactional brands in the benchmark set say 'Book Now'; consultative ones say 'Book a Consultation'.
footer: Stone Surgical Arts cross-link (Scenario B only)

A_two_competing_sites.description: Both brands sell the same menu in the same city under the same surgeon.
A_two_competing_sites.impact: Search cannibalisation between /services and /services/botox and their published Surgical Arts equivalents.
A_two_competing_sites.verdict: Name this as the one to avoid. It is what happens by default if nobody decides.

B_menu_moves_here.description: The non-surgical menu is cut out of Stone Surgical Arts and moved to the med spa, split on modality.
B_menu_moves_here.impact: Sitemap as proposed, plus a redirect map from the Surgical Arts treatment URLs and edits to a site the client has already reviewed.
B_menu_moves_here.verdict: Recommended. NassifMD is a live, market-tested instance: one surgeon, two domains, split surgical/non-surgical, cross-linked by a header brand switcher.

C_different_brand.description: Memberships, maintenance, wellness — a different product that happens to share a treatment room.
C_different_brand.impact: /services and /services/botox are rewritten or dropped; /membership becomes the hero and / is built around it.
C_different_brand.verdict: Viable. Viva shows the shape when two brands share one domain.

open_questions: Trading name — 'Stone Med Spa' or 'Westlake Medical Aesthetics'? Every URL and H1 here is provisional.
Brand identity — no logo, palette or type system found. All 5 benchmark sites use custom photography; none use stock. Sits ahead of design on the critical path.
Before-and-after consent — per-case written consent needed before /results can carry photography.
Virtual consultation — operational answer needed before /book-consultation can be designed.
Are the five legal/utility pages in scope?

benchmarks.name: NassifMD Medical Spa
benchmarks.lesson: Surgeon's med spa as a separate brand, split on modality, joined by a header brand switcher

benchmarks.name: Beverly Hills Med Spa
benchmarks.lesson: Concern-first IA: 24 concern pages plus a concern search box

benchmarks.name: Skin Solutions Collective
benchmarks.lesson: Closest 1:1 to our brief at a buildable size; named membership tiers

benchmarks.name: Ject
benchmarks.lesson: Treatments merchandised as products; strongest membership and booking machinery

benchmarks.name: Viva Day Spa + Med Spa
benchmarks.lesson: Texas; two brands under one roof; the only benchmark with a financing page
